$comment: The minimap and the explored-world map (docs/adr/0068-minimap-and-explored-map.md; owner, 2026-11-08). minimap: radiusM (the disc's reach, m), texelM (metres a texel), sizePx (its CSS size), compactSizePx on a screen whose short side is less than compactBelowPx (a phone either way up: the full size covered the touch look area sideways and the hotbar and status lines upright), moveTexels and turnDegrees (the disc is drawn again only when the player has moved this many texels or turned this far), refreshSeconds (the terrain under it is read again this often, for edits), scanUpM and scanDownM (how far above and below the eye a column's top is looked for), playerColor (the red dot), otherColor (other players' dots), dotPx (a dot's size), edgeColor (the ring), cpuUpdateMs (the CPU adapter's tier: on a software renderer the minimap and its dots are brought up to date at most this often, ms). heightShading: the toggle's default (Settings, On screen: the minimap in the big map's height colours instead of its blocks' colours, to compare), waterDepthM (the minimap's height colours read water's depth to here; its colour is darkened by its depth as the generated map darkens it, shared/look/lodmap.json waterDepthM and waterDeepShade, so an explored sea reads as the generated one). heightTint (the big map's look always, the minimap's when heightShading is on; owner, 2026-11-09: block colours "lightly tinted by height", after the 0.50.53 height bands hid the sand): each cell its block colour scaled in brightness by its height above sea level, darkest at or below lowM, brightest at highM, linear between, then above it toward white, peakLighten of the way at or above peakM (0.52.27: high ground past 400 m keeps a gradient up a 5000 m peak; below highM unchanged) (water keeps its colour, already darkened by its depth). explored: cellM (a coarse cell is explored once its centre is within the minimap's radius of the player, a 2D distance on their face, whatever the height and whether its terrain is loaded), pendingColor (an explored cell's colour until the loaded terrain or the generator gives it one). bigMap: levels (owner, 2026-11-09: "at most 5 zoom levels", the closest "the mini map size", the widest "the entire world/island"; 2–5 of them, closest first; owner, 2026-11-10: "Maybe we just have 3 zoom levels. The two coarse ones load along with the area around you in 1m. The 1m is always streamed"): each level's reach (where the background builds its tiles, map open or shut: player round the player within prebuildSpans of its span, island every tile touching the island, islandRadius in shared/protocol/constants.json, disc every tile touching the world disc; the open view's tiles always first) and cellM (a map cell's side, m: its own detail, a whole power of two, rising; 1 m a cell up close), the span each shows across the panel's short side computed by the generator (the closest the minimap's diameter, the widest the whole world disc's, worldRadius × 2 in shared/protocol/constants.json, owner 2026-11-09: "the whole world surface" … "Including all the water"; the rest spaced geometrically between; the coarser levels' cells chosen so the background builds about as many tiles as before), startLevel (the level the map opens at, 0 the closest), wheelStepPx (the scroll that steps one level), pinchStep (the pinch spread or squeeze that steps one level), fogColor (unexplored), and the panel it is drawn in (owner, 2026-11-09): panelFraction (its share of the screen's width and height, the game showing round it), phoneMarginPx (its margin inside the safe area on a screen whose short side is under minimap.compactBelowPx, where it is nearly full screen), buttonPx and phoneButtonPx (the close, zoom and centre buttons' size), scaleBarMaxPx (the scale bar's longest; its length a 1, 2 or 5 times ten metres), frameColor (its title bar and frame), padPanPxPerS (the controller's stick or D-pad pans this many pixels a second at full tilt), and the controller's buttons on the open map (shared/input/gamepad.json's names): padZoomIn, padZoomInAlt, padZoomOut, padZoomOutAlt (a press steps one level), padCenter, padClose (View closes it too). revealed (the map's tiles, every level's, generated from the terrain generator in the job workers and kept per world and build in this browser, IndexedDB dwell-map-tiles, so each is built once; in a mode with the mapRevealed ability, creative, nothing is fogged, elsewhere unexplored ground is): tileCells (a tile is this many cells of its level a side, generated as one job), jobsInFlight (at most this many tiles generating at once for the open map, so chunk streaming keeps its workers), backgroundJobs (at most this many building in the background while the map is shut or its view is whole), prebuildSpans (a player-reach level's tiles are built within this many of its spans round the player; the island and disc levels' whole, nearest the open view's centre or else the player first, the player level first, then the coarsest; every level's tiles are clipped to the world disc only, so there are no holes inside the world; outside the disc the panel shows fogColor), budgetMs (the most a frame spends taking finished tiles), redrawMs (the open map is drawn again at most this often while tiles arrive), and the closest levels' real blocks (owner, 2026-11-09: "big map closest zooms should use 1m"): a level whose cellM is at most liveMaxCellM (0: none) is drawn, while the map is open, from the loaded terrain as the minimap reads it (each cell its column's top block at the cell's centre: grass, sand, water, leaves, paths, builds and edits), the generator's tile showing where nothing is loaded; liveTilesPerFrame (the most of those tiles read from the terrain a frame, the nearest the view's centre first) and liveRefreshMs (a tile is read again this often while it shows, for edits; never kept in the store). Run `node shared/ui/gen.mjs` after editing; CI fails if crates/dwell-game/src/map.gen.rs or client/src/ui/map.gen.ts is stale.
